stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: One rota tool, for anything at all
stations.note: Three copies of the same code.

stations.title: Hut programs
stations.text: A rota for skippers, another for boats

stations.title: Your tools
stations.gap: Every type needs its own copy

captions: The hut's programs. Bridie wants one rota tool that works for skippers, boats, anything.
Today each kind of list has its own copy of the same code, and they drift apart.
You write a pair of any types, a rota for any list, and the largest of anything.
Now one rota tool turns every rota on a week, whatever it holds.
One rota tool for the whole hut. Part 6 is done: everyone counted, in order.
